lines.text: Many learners say: I live here since 2020.
Better: I have lived here since 2020.
Since needs have plus a verb.
Lived! I have lived here for years.

data.why: Since needs have plus a verb.

native.tip: Với “since/for” cần hiện tại hoàn thành: have + quá khứ phân từ.
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “I live here since 2020.” không? 😅 Có “since” thì dùng have + V3: “I have lived here since 2020.” Nghe thầy Carlos đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “lived”. Kể bạn sống ở đâu bao lâu bằng “I have lived…”. Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.tip: With “since” you need the present perfect: have plus past participle.
en.caption: Do you often say “I live here since 2020.”? With “since” use have + past participle: “I have lived here since 2020.” Listen to Carlos read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
